title: StarSystemTable
description: Shape of one star system file, e.g. data/world/systems/cradle.json - the one system of MVP-1 (GDD section 36). The designer owns the values. hard_boundary_radius_m has a hard maximum of 20,000 and that ceiling is NOT a balance number: it is the distance at which a float32 world coordinate still holds sub-2 mm precision without a Floating Origin (ADR-0009 section 3). A design that needs a bigger world needs that slice first, and the schema is where it finds that out rather than after the camera starts shaking. 단위 접미사 규약: 모든 수치 필드 이름이 단위로 끝난다 (_m, _mps, _mps2, _deg_s, _deg_s2, _ms, _s, _hz, _t, _ly, _kib_s, _ticks). 스키마가 모든 필드를 명시 선언하므로 접미사는 propertyNames 패턴이 아니라 이 선언 자체가 강제한다. 데이터 테이블은 와이어 계약과 달리 실수(SI 단위)를 쓴다 (ADR-0009 section 2의 명시적 예외). 이 값들은 와이어를 왕복하지 않고 기동 시 한 번 읽히며, 튜닝하는 사람이 읽을 수 있어야 한다. 서버 내부 상태도 같은 SI f64라 변환이 없다.

id.description: Stable content id, lower-kebab. Distinct from the persisted world_id UUID, which the server owns. Written into SHIP_SPAWNED.star_system_id.

reference_markers.description: CLIENT-SIDE STATIC VISUALS ONLY. No server entity, no server state, no collision, never in a snapshot. They exist because without a fixed object in view a player cannot tell whether the ship is moving, which would make this slice's stated goal unverifiable by eye.

CoordinateSpace.title: StarSystemCoordinateSpace
CoordinateSpace.description: Declarative only - the server does not read a handedness from here. THE AXIS CONVENTION IS FIXED BY ADR-0009 section 1 AND IS LEFT-HANDED, Y-up, +Z forward, matching the only renderer that consumes it. A conversion layer between server and client is where sign bugs live, so there is none.

soft_boundary_radius_m.description: Beyond this radius the server adds a constant pull toward the origin. A wall you are warned about is not a wall.

hard_boundary_radius_m.description: The wall. Position is projected onto this sphere and outward radial velocity removed (I-34). Maximum 20,000 is the float32 budget of ADR-0009 section 3, not a design choice.

client_float32_ulp_at_hard_boundary_m.description: Documentation of the precision argument. Not read by code.

floating_origin_required_above_radius_m.description: Documentation only. The enforced ceiling is the maximum on hard_boundary_radius_m above; this field records where the designer believes the real limit is, and the two disagreeing is a conversation, not a build failure.

Spawn.title: StarSystemSpawn
Spawn.description: Deterministic and auditable: a seeded hash picks a starting index and clearance probing walks forward from it. No random number generator is involved (principle 9).

point_count.description: Must equal the length of points_m. The server refuses to start if they disagree.

clearance_m.description: A spawn point is taken only if no active or lingering ship is within clearance_m + hull_radius_m of it.

assignment_rule.description: Prose statement of the rule the server implements. Not parsed. It is here so that a reader of the data and a reader of the code can find each other.

points_m.description: Spawn positions in system-local metres, each [x, y, z]. Every point must lie inside the hard boundary; the server checks this at startup.

Presence.title: StarSystemPresence
Presence.description: A disconnected ship does not vanish. It coasts, the assist brings it to rest, and it stays visible. Reconnecting in time resumes the SAME ship where it is.

linger_seconds.description: How long a pilotless ship stays in the world after its session closes. SHIP_DESPAWNED fires when this expires.

reconnect_resume_window_seconds.description: How long the same actor may reconnect and reclaim the ship. Must not exceed linger_seconds: you cannot reclaim a ship that no longer exists. The server refuses to start if it does.
